data.name: خُلَيباہ
data.gender_notes: خُلَيباہ is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الفعل العربي خَلَبَ الذي يعني افترس أو أخذ الشيء بخداع وغش. وهو يُستخدم أيضًا للإشارة إلى الأسد، أحد أقوى الحيوانات وأكثرهم شجاعة. يُستخدم هذا الاسم تشجيعًا للأطفال على القوة والشجاعة والتمسك بالحق. The name خُلَيباہ carries the meaning “Young plant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose خُلَيباہ usually hope their child will grow to embody young plant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Being named after a young plant symbolizes growth, nurturing, and development. This name encourages one to embrace change and continue to evolve throughout life.

At various stages of growth, the young palm tree must endure trials and challenges, much like a human being faces hardships in their lives. By drawing parallels between the resilience of a seed that grows into a tree and the trials and tribulations experienced by individuals, the name offers a powerful reminder of the importance of patience, perseverance, and faith during difficult times. Additionally, the name can serve as a source of inspiration and motivation for those seeking to grow spiritually, encouraging them to cultivate their inner selves and nurture their connection to the divine.
